'''Curt Willham''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked for the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When the [[Justicars' Brigade]] paid the Black Sun money to smuggle [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifacts]] offworld, Willham was one of the smugglers implanted with an artifact. Willham started hurting badly from the artifact inside of him, and was taken care of by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Maer (doctor)|Maer]] with the help of a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] in the [[Silent Sun cantina]].
